items.source:
Strategy to decide if the application context hierarchy (parent contexts) should be
considered.
items.translation: 决定是否应考虑应用程序上下文层次结构（父上下文）的策略。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with type(), but it may be used instead of type().
items.translation: 此属性不能与type()一起使用，但可以作为type()的替代方案。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with value(), but it may be used instead of value().
items.translation: 此属性不能与value()一起使用，但可以替代value()。

items.source: The condition will also match if multiple matching bean instances are already contained in the BeanFactory but a primary candidate has been defined; essentially, the condition match if auto-wiring a bean with the defined type will succeed.
items.translation: 该条件在 BeanFactory 中已包含多个匹配的 Bean 实例，但已定义了一个主要候选者时也会匹配；本质上，如果自动装配具有所定义类型的 Bean 能够成功，则该条件匹配。

items.source: the class type of the bean to check
items.translation: 要检查的 Bean 的类类型

items.source: the class type name of the bean to check
items.translation: 要检查的 Bean 的类类型名称

items.source:
The condition can only match the bean definitions that have been processed by the
application context so far and, as such, it is strongly recommended to use this
condition on auto-configuration classes only. If a candidate bean may be created by
another auto-configuration, make sure that the one using this condition runs after.
items.translation: 该条件仅能匹配到目前为止已由应用程序上下文处理的 Bean 定义，因此强烈建议仅在自动配置类中使用此条件。如果候选 Bean 可能由另一个自动配置创建，请确保使用此条件的配置在其之后运行。

items.source: The class type name of bean that should be checked.
items.translation: 应检查的 Bean 的类类型名称。

items.source: The class type of bean that should be checked.
items.translation: 应检查的 Bean 的类类型。
